submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on the current token through a gate-by-key conjunction: the gate opens when the token is the singular head noun of a sentence-initial 'The/A/Our + NOUN' phrase, the complement noun of the fixed evidential frame 'According to the NOUN', or a noun immediately following a same-field noun (compounds and credential clusters such as 'password manager', 'file manager', 'login credential'), and the key matches a memorized field of representational artifacts -- recorded-information media (record, report, document, book, file, letter, message, photo, account), access credentials (password, login, credential), and observation/communication instruments and storage (telescope, camera, phone, radio, storage) -- with peak strengths from ~0.4 to above the scan maximum realized in the gate-open (g>0) regime with negative up-projection. It fires weakly or not at all on the same nouns used as verbs (record, report), as plurals, after demonstratives, or as mid-sentence verb complements, on animate, natural-kind, building, vehicle and heavy-machine, material and mass, and abstract nouns in identical frames (teacher, manager alone, engineer, dog, sun, moon, house, window, car, machine, device, engine, paper, salt, system, function, truth), and on all other tokens shows only a diffuse gate-closed-regime response at or below 0.45 of scan maximum (prepositions, determiners and complement or measure nouns inside PPs and adjuncts such as by, the, to, of, mat, storm, level, year, mg, and periods).
